rules.name: Register recurring assets before generation
rules.enforcement: Every recurring or visually important character, wardrobe, creature, animal, vehicle, location, interior, prop, weapon, tool, effect, damage state, and period reference requires a manifest entry.

rules.name: Asset IDs never renumber
rules.enforcement: Approved permanent IDs remain stable when assets are inserted, reordered, or versioned.

rules.name: Store complete asset records
rules.enforcement: Store ID, name, category, description, references, approval, version, locked and mutable traits, state, first and last sequence, notes, and relationships.

rules.name: Reference roles are explicit
rules.enforcement: Every active reference identifies asset ID, file, control role, priority, and state version; unrelated responsibilities cannot be blended.

rules.name: Use minimum sufficient references
rules.enforcement: Use only relevant approved references to avoid ambiguity and accidental blending.

rules.name: Reuse approved locked assets
rules.enforcement: Do not generate or replace an approved LOCKED asset unless the user explicitly creates a new version.

rules.name: Persist asset relationships
rules.enforcement: Link wears, rides, uses, carries, appears-in, owns, and state-version relationships by permanent IDs.
